[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-9c[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob ref create files its own references (ingest at birth)[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A successful `bob ref create` on athena, apollo, or the Mac leaves [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the reference in the library — PDF in `lib/`, ref note written, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reading task filed — committed and pushed as one commit, so `bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ref scan` becomes a repair tool instead of a daily step. When [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]inline ingest cannot run, the PDF stays queued in that host's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`xlib/` with a visible reason and a per-host `bob ref scan [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]--intake-only` timer files it later.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]ref_ingest_at_birth.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/ref_ingest_at_birth.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-9c[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-9c/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Writing scans hold the vault-maintenance lock[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]scan-sync-lock[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scan-sync-lock: make every writing `bob ref scan` (human and JSON) take [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob_sync.lock before scan.lock and hold both through intake and note [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]writes. This closes the window where vault-sync pushes a library PDF [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]without its ref note. Add the `lock_busy` error and document the lock [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]order.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared intake session and create wiring[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]create-ingest[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]create-ingest: build the shared locked intake session in a new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]highlights_ref intake module. It takes the locks, pre-syncs, re-checks, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]moves, plans with rollback, writes, makes one scoped commit, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-syncs. Wire it into every `bob ref create` route in place of `next:[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob ref scan`. Add `-k/--keep-intake`, the `highlights.ingest_on_create`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]switch, and `BOB_HIGHLIGHTS_INGEST_ON_CREATE`, with scratch-vault [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]integration tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ingest for listen-attach, ref jobs, and gkeep pull[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]producer-ingest[dim] · [dim][/dim]after create-ingest[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]producer-ingest: route the remaining PDF producers through the intake [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]session. These are the `--listen` attach path (audio-only units), [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`ingest_url` (the capture ref-jobs worker and `bob gkeep pull`), and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]their outcome types. Add ingested/queued states to `bob ref jobs` and to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gkeep output.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob ref scan --intake-only drain[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]scan-intake-only[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scan-sync-lock, create-ingest[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scan-intake-only: add `bob ref scan -i/--intake-only`. It drains the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]local xlib/ queue through the intake session, with one commit per [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reference, and skips the annotation pass and the pre-scan hook. It [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refuses `-w`, adds additive JSON fields, and exits non-zero while [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]anything stays queued, so timers surface stuck items.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Intake health in bob ref doctor[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]intake-health[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scan-intake-only[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]intake-health: record a per-host intake status file (last success and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]last failure) from create, producers, and scans. Teach `bob ref doctor` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to show it, plus the age of the oldest queued xlib/ PDF, warning past [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]one hour.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-host drains, bridge retirement, docs, and rollout[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tailnet-rollout[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scan-sync-lock, create-ingest, producer-ingest, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]scan-intake-only, intake-health[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tailnet-rollout: in chezmoi, add the Linux bob-ref-intake systemd timer,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]retire the bob_xlib_pull bridge and pre_scan_hook, and fix the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]maybe_bob_highlights_sync gate. Rewrite the Highlights intake docs. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Deploy to the hosts per the rollout decision, verify, and record the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decision strand.[/#D7D7AF]
